mapper.select: SELECT id, scope, scope_id, provider, base_url, model, api_key, enabled, allow_personal, updated_by, updated_at FROM ai_shared_setting WHERE scope = #{scope} AND scope_id = #{scopeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_shared_setting (scope, scope_id, provider, base_url, model, api_key, enabled, allow_personal, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{scope}, #{scopeId}, #{provider}, #{baseUrl}, #{model}, #{apiKey}, #{enabled}, #{allowPersonal}, #{updatedBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider = VALUES(provider), base_url = VALUES(base_url), model = VALUES(model), api_key = VALUES(api_key), enabled = VALUES(enabled), allow_personal = VALUES(allow_personal), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
